qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialty polymer formulation know-how and aerospace composite qualifications provide customer stickiness, but the business fails the empirical proof-of-moat test: ROCE is sub-hurdle at 8.1-8.8%, organic EBITDA fell 12% in FY2025, and fluoropolymers face persistent, multi-billion-dollar PFAS regulatory bans and environmental litigation liabilities.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Proof of Moat & Pricing, REJECT). Capital efficiency fails hurdle with ROCE of 8.1-8.8% and EBITDA contracting 12% in FY2025. Fluoropolymer portfolio carries material terminal PFAS regulatory liabilities and environmental remediation costs.
qualitative.evidence: Spun off from Solvay in Dec 2023, Syensqo generated ROCE of only 8.1-8.8% in 2024-2025, well below the 12% ROIC requirement. FY2025 net sales fell 3% to €6.14B and underlying EBITDA dropped 12% organically to €1.21B due to volume declines across Specialty Polymers and Technology Solutions. Ongoing PFAS environmental liabilities include a €167M NJDEP settlement and severe EU regulatory phase-out risks.
